postmortem.issue: master 建卡时 diagnosis 错 (指到 utils.test.ts, 真凶是 validate-runner)
postmortem.root_cause: master 只看 CI raw log 里的 error 日志顺序推断, 未独立复现. pino error 日志和 FATAL 时间相邻但因果无关.
postmortem.corrected_by: Performer independently ran vitest utils.test.ts alone → 23/23 PASS, 排除嫌疑; 然后跑 sentinel-d 单独复现 FATAL; 找到 validate-runner 入口点问题
postmortem.lesson: Fact-Forcing 第二重: 'raw output 相邻 ≠ 因果'. 建 bugfix ticket 时必须独立复现, 不能只看 CI log 推断.

verification.fix_summary: Added CLI entry-point guard in node/src/scripts/validate-runner.ts. Imported fileURLToPath from node:url. main() invocation (previously top-level, lines 96-99) now wrapped in `if (isMainModule)` guard using standard ESM `import.meta.url === fileURLToPath === process.argv[1]` pattern. When imported by dead-code sentinel, main() is skipped; when run as CLI, behavior is identical to before.

changes.node/src/scripts/validate-runner.ts: Added `import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'` (line 1). Wrapped top-level main() call in isMainModule guard (previously lines 96-99, now lines 98-111).
changes.node/tests/dead-code-sentinel-coverage-d: No changes needed — sentinel assertion `expect(m).toBeDefined()` still holds since module still exports validateAll indirectly; only main() side-effect is gated.
